Change hints: vendor webhooks / schedule (ids only)
Agent Identity (SPIFFE) per Agent Runtime deployment

Every agent tool call traverses Agent Gateway egress under a per-deployment Agent Identity; analysis identities can only reach read-only tools; only AID-COMMIT reaches write tools, and only with an approval token minted after an IAP-authenticated PM decision.
